/bin/bash -lc "db='assets/data/career_path.db'
sqlite3 -readonly -header -column \""'$db" <<'"'SQL'
WITH RECURSIVE chain(target_id,id,parent_id,name,path) AS (
  SELECT id,id,parent_id,name,name FROM career_nodes WHERE id IN (88,145,144,330,146)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT chain.target_id,p.id,p.parent_id,p.name,p.name || ' > ' || chain.path
  FROM chain JOIN career_nodes p ON p.id=chain.parent_id
), roots AS (
  SELECT target_id, path FROM chain WHERE parent_id IS NULL
)
SELECT roots.target_id AS career_node_id, cn.slug AS career_node_slug, s.name || ' > ' || roots.path AS breadcrumb
FROM roots JOIN career_nodes cn ON cn.id=roots.target_id JOIN streams s ON s.id=cn.stream_id ORDER BY roots.target_id;
SQL"
